external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
external_entities.notes: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer. There is no second factor.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The person who receives an invoice email and uses the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
external_entities.notes: The payer's trust zone is not stated.

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: An agent working from the support office network who uses the admin console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
external_entities.notes: Each agent signs in with their own account and a one-time code.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users and accessed by the payment page and admin console.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The app applies company filters to queries, loads invoices by invoice number, saves every field received from the invoice edit form, queues PDF render jobs, and fetches PDFs.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: The console used by support agents to open billing-app sessions as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The console is reachable only from the support office network.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: Every table has a company ID column. The database has no row-level security, and the app uses one database account for all companies.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared cloud bucket containing generated PDFs under company IDs and invoice numbers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs using one service credential for all companies.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue holding PDF render jobs containing a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_stores.notes: The queue's location and protection are not recorded.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user uses the billing app in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.notes: Users sign in with an email address and password and receive a session cookie. There is no second factor.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer records, payout bank details, credentials, session cookie, and invoice edits.

data_flows.name: open payment page
data_flows.description: A payer follows the invoice link and opens the payment page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.notes: The payment page asks the payer to sign in to nothing.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice number, invoice, company name, and company bank details.

data_flows.name: send invoice email
data_flows.description: The billing app sends an invoice email containing a link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.notes: The email transport is not described.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice link containing the invoice number.

data_flows.name: access tenant database
data_flows.description: The billing app reads and writes tenant data in the database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database
data_flows.notes: The app adds the company filter to each query and connects with one database account for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, invoice edits, paid flags, and recorded user actions.

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app puts a PDF render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.notes: The job carries a company ID and an invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number.

data_flows.name: read render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID the job carries.
data_flows.data_description: Render job containing a company ID and invoice number.

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer uses the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice identified by company ID and invoice number.

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes the generated PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.notes: The PDF is stored under the company ID and invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: Generated invoice PDF.

data_flows.name: fetch PDF
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.notes: One service credential is used for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Generated invoice PDFs.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.notes: The admin console is reachable only from the support office network.
data_flows.authentication: agent's own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Account credentials and one-time code.

data_flows.name: open user session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as any customer user.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: Actions performed in the session are recorded against the customer user rather than the agent.
data_flows.data_description: Customer-user session identity and session activity.

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The tenant boundary for people belonging to a customer company.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant
trust_boundaries.notes: Each user belongs to one company.

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.
trust_boundaries.notes: The admin console is reachable only from this network.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform containing the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform
trust_boundaries.notes: The placement of the render queue and PDF renderer is not stated.

assumptions.assumption: The tenant database holds confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The database contains invoices, customer records, and payout bank details.

assumptions.assumption: The PDF bucket holds confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The bucket contains generated PDFs of invoices, which include invoice and bank-detail information.

assumptions.assumption: The render queue holds confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The queue holds company IDs and invoice numbers identifying invoice render jobs.
